content:
- Model consistently overestimates early in the 30-day forecast horizon, especially in the first 5–10 days.
- Model underestimates prices after sharp spikes (e.g., 75+), failing to capture rebound or mean reversion.
- Forecast tends to lag behind true price movements by 1–3 days, particularly in downward trends.
- Model exhibits persistent bias toward higher values in the middle of the forecast, especially when history shows volatility.
- Overshoots occur after high historical peaks; model fails to adjust downward quickly enough.
- Mean reversion is under-predicted — model holds onto high forecasts longer than actual price behavior.
- Forecast sensitivity to recent high values is too strong; model overreacts to short-term spikes.
- Model underestimates low-price periods (e.g., 68–70 range) and fails to anticipate sharp drops from high levels.
